info.title: DEP control plane
info.description:
The control plane and the events plane of the Document Editing Protocol 1.0 (draft), generated from packages/protocol/src/definition (05 §6, §7; SPK-019, PRO-002, PRO-003).

Conventions (05 §6.1): JSON bodies; errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a `code` from the registry; every mutable resource has an `ETag` and updates require `If-Match`; POST requests that create something accept an `Idempotency-Key` (scoped to the tenant, the caller, the route and a hash of the body, remembered for 24 hours); lists are `{ items, nextCursor }` with an opaque `cursor` and a `limit` of at most 200; requests may carry `traceparent`.

Browsers: the service answers CORS preflights for the tenant's allowed origins, allows the headers Authorization, Content-Type, If-Match, Idempotency-Key, DEP-Actor and traceparent, and exposes ETag, Retry-After, Deprecation and Sunset.

A resource addressed by a bare identifier (`/threads/{tid}`, `/exports/{jid}`, `/assets/{aid}`) is resolved to its document, and the caller's token must cover that document.

Success statuses follow decision D61 (200 with a body, 201 when a resource is created, 202 when a job is started, 204 without a body). Problem responses are declared as `4XX` and `5XX` ranges; the status of each code is its `httpStatus` in the registry (spec/dep/dep-1.registry.json), and a missing `If-Match` is 428 with `precondition_failed`. Every response carries `DEP-Request-Id` (D71). Placeholders for bodies the prose does not define are marked with their gap (decision D26).

DocRole.title: DocRole
DocRole.description: A document-level role, carried in the `docs` claim (05 §3.1; 07 §2).

RegionRole.title: RegionRole
RegionRole.description: A role a region grant may give (07 §2).

Restriction.title: Restriction
Restriction.description: An output restriction from the `restrict` claim (05 §3.1; 13 §5).

FeatureName.title: FeatureName
FeatureName.description: A feature name. Protocol and CDM features share one namespace; experimental names start with `x-` (05 §1).

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: A code of the error registry (05 §5.8).

Step.title: Step
Step.description: A step as produced by `Step.toJSON()` of the pinned prosemirror-transform release (04 §4). Validated by the authority, not by the envelope.

stepType.description: The step type. The authority accepts only the seven known types and rejects any other with `invalid_op` (04 §4), so the wire format accepts any string.

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: Origin of a commit: a client hint (recorded, never trusted) or a server-reserved origin (04 §3.1).

Author.title: Author
Author.description: Server attribution of a commit (04 G6).

user.description: The user the commit is attributed to: the host's `sub` (D42), or `system` (04 §10).

session.description: The session; null for server-authored commits.

agent.description: The assistant that acted for the user, or null (13 §6.2).

ControlChange.title: ControlChange
ControlChange.description: The change a control commit records (04 §3.2). Only `{ "type": "grants", "rev": n }` appears in the prose.

type.description: What changed (04 §3.2 lists grants revisions, region states, lease breaks, workflow transitions and participant completion).

RemoteCommit.title: RemoteCommit
RemoteCommit.description: A stored commit as broadcast in `sync.commit` (05 §5.3).

steps.description: The steps as applied; empty for a control commit. For a read-restricted reader, the steps of its class, which are empty when the commit changed only hidden content (ADR 0019, proposed).

control.description: The change a control commit records; null for a step commit.

CdmRange.title: CdmRange
CdmRange.description: A range of CDM major versions (05 §2).

ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails
ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details with the `code` member (05 §6.1).

code.description: A code of the registry (05 §5.8); `status` is the code's HTTP status in the registry (D61).

violations.description: For `validation_failed`: where the body breaks which rule. Never the offending value (BE-088).

path.description: A JSON Pointer into the request body.

retryAfterMs.description: For `rate_limited` of the access code (FRW-039): how long to wait before retrying; `Retry-After` carries the same wait in whole seconds.

Discovery.title: Discovery
Discovery.description: The discovery document at `{endpoint}/.well-known/dep` (05 §2). Every member listed is required; it is the same for every tenant of the endpoint and needs no token (D66).

ws.description: The WebSocket address; the subprotocol is `dep.v1`.

rest.description: The complete REST base URL; resource paths are relative to it.

jwks_uri.description: The public keys of the tokens the service mints (`POST /tokens`), so that a host can check them. Never used to verify a host-signed token, whose keys come from the tenant registration (05 §3.1).

Content.title: Content
Content.description: Document content at a `seq` (05 §6.2): the CDM envelope plus `seq` and `incarnation`.

requires.description: Features the document uses; a reader that lacks one MUST refuse it (03 §2).

doc.description: The document root, valid against the CDM schema.

view.description: The view token of the reader's visibility class that this content belongs to (ADR 0019, proposed). A client resumes a channel opened from this content with it.

CdmEnvelope.title: CdmEnvelope
CdmEnvelope.description: A CDM document as stored and transferred (03 §2).

TokenRequest.title: TokenRequest
TokenRequest.description: The claims a host asks the service to mint (05 §3.1); member names are the claim names. The service sets `iss`, `aud`, `iat`, `exp`, `jti` and `tid` itself.

sub.description: Opaque, stable user identifier; hosts SHOULD NOT use e-mail addresses.

docs.description: Document identifiers (at most 20) mapped to the role in each.

auth_time.description: When the host authenticated the participant (12 §7).

expiresIn.description: Lifetime in seconds; at most and by default 900 (15 minutes, 05 §3.1).

token.description: The minted user token (a JWS in compact form).

RevokeRequest.title: RevokeRequest
RevokeRequest.description: Ends a user's access before the token expires (05 §3.3).

sub.description: The user, as the `sub` claim names them.

doc.description: Limits the watermark to this document: the user's tokens issued before it are refused for this document only.

CreateDocumentRequest.title: CreateDocumentRequest
CreateDocumentRequest.description: Creates a document, optionally from CDM content, a template or an import (05 §6.2). At most one of `content`, `template` and `import`.

content.description: Initial CDM content: the content at seq 0 (D67). Without it the document starts empty.

template.description: A template (`POST /templates`) to instantiate (12 §9; FRW-062): the new document is a fork of the template document at `templateSeq`.

templateSeq.description: With `template`: the seq of the template document to fork at, pinned and recorded. Default: the head.

participants.description: With `template`: participants bound to the roles of the template. They are stored as the draft workflow of the new document.

roles.description: The `role_def` identifiers of the template that the person holds.

values.description: With `template`: values to prefill by field key, in the same call. All or none are applied.

import.description: An asset to import. Refused with `validation_failed` until imports exist (EXP).

externalId.description: The host's identifier; unique in the tenant (`conflict` otherwise).

DocumentResource.title: DocumentResource
DocumentResource.description: Document metadata (05 §6.2). Title, owner and timestamps live here, never in the CDM (03 §2). The ETag is the metadata revision.

template.description: Only in the answer to `POST /documents` with `template`: the template and the pinned seq the document was forked at (FRW-062).

UpdateDocumentRequest.title: UpdateDocumentRequest
UpdateDocumentRequest.description: A JSON merge patch of the document resource: a member present replaces it, `null` clears it. Needs `manage` or a service credential.

state.description: A change of state raises the grants revision and is recorded as a control commit (07 §9).

RegionEditors.title: RegionEditors
RegionEditors.description: "Who can edit" a region (05 §6.2), from the region policy, its state, its lease and the stored grants; the document roles themselves are in the hosts' tokens.

roles.description: Document roles that may edit the region by role alone (07 §4): `editor` and `owner` under `inherit`, `owner` under `restricted`; none while the region is approved.

principals.description: Principals with an `editor` grant on the region that has not expired; none while the region is approved.

leasedTo.description: The holder of a lease on the region; while it holds, only they may edit (07 §10).

RegionInfo.title: RegionInfo
RegionInfo.description: An entry of the derived region list, computed from the content at the head (05 §6.2).

policy.description: The region policy (07 §4); `confidential` comes from ADR 0019 (proposed).

order.description: Position among the regions of the body, from 0, in document order.

RegionGrant.title: RegionGrant
RegionGrant.description: A region grant: document, region, principal, role, optional expiry (07 §1).

Grants.title: Grants
Grants.description: The region grants of a document (05 §6.2). Once a PATCH has returned, no commit can be stored under the old revision (04 G7).

rev.description: The grants revision (07 §9): every change of grants, region states, leases or the document state raises it. The ETag is derived from it.

grants.description: A JSON merge patch of the resource: the list replaces the current grants. A grant names an existing, unretired region; one grant per region and principal.

seq.description: For `approved`: the `seq` at approval (07 §11).

hash.description: For `approved`: the hash of the region's canonical content (07 §11).

Lease.title: Lease
Lease.description: An exclusive-edit lease: an identifier, a holder and an expiry (07 §10).

HistoryGroup.title: HistoryGroup
HistoryGroup.description: A group of commits (08 §4). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

Version.title: Version
Version.description: A pointer to a `seq` with a kind (08 §4). No identifier is named.

seq.description: Defaults to the head.

DiffChange.title: DiffChange
DiffChange.description: One change of a comparison, keyed by block identifier (08 §6, from its example).

Attribution.title: Attribution
Attribution.description: Who wrote which spans, for a region or a block range (08 §7). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

dryRun.description: Returns the comparison a restore would produce (08 §8).

RestoreResult.title: RestoreResult
RestoreResult.description: The outcome of a restore (08 §8). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

ForkRequest.title: ForkRequest
ForkRequest.description: Forks a document. The member for "whether grants are copied" is not named.

ReadMarker.title: ReadMarker
ReadMarker.description: The caller's last seen `seq`; it only moves forward (08 §10).

ConnectHint.title: ConnectHint
ConnectHint.description: Where a client should open its channel (06 §2.1). A hint only: it grants nothing.

url.description: The WebSocket URL to open the channel on.

node.description: The node the URL belongs to; empty when the service names no node.

source.description: Where the URL came from: the owner of the document, rendezvous routing over the live nodes, or the address of the service itself.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: Changes and comment activity by other people since the caller's read marker (08 §10). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

CommentInput.title: CommentInput
CommentInput.description: A comment body; it may contain mentions (13 §5). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

CreateThreadRequest.title: CreateThreadRequest
CreateThreadRequest.description: The room maps the range to the head and checks `comment` there (05 §6.2).

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: A comment. Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

AssetUpload.title: AssetUpload
AssetUpload.description: An asset identifier and a size-bound pre-signed upload into a quarantine area (05 §6.2). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

locale.description: Default: the document's language (`settings.lang`), else `en-GB`. The job records the value it used.

timeZone.description: An IANA zone name. Default `UTC`. The job records the value it used.

target.description: A target the server does not support is refused with `validation_failed`.

seq.description: Defaults to the head when the request is accepted; above the head is `validation_failed`.

options.description: `options.suggestions` is required when the document has unresolved suggestions (`pending_suggestions`). Passed to the job unchanged.

ExportResult.title: ExportResult
ExportResult.description: The result of a completed export (09 §9.1). Warnings are in the job's `diagnostics`.

url.description: A short-lived signed URL of the output, issued after the permission check of the request that returned it (10 §3.7).

pages.description: The page count; null for a target without pages.

layout.description: A signed URL of `layout.json` (09 §11); null when there is none.

converged.description: Whether page references converged; null for a target without pages.

log.description: A signed URL of the raw compile log: only for the requester, and only while they have `edit` (09 §9.2; 07 §12).

chainHead.description: The hash-chain head of the exported state, as in the export's manifest, so that a host can anchor it (08 §12); null when the log has no commit at that `seq`.

imagesWithoutAlt.description: The number of images and figures without alternative text in the exported content, one per occurrence (09 §13). Each is also a diagnostic with the code `image_without_alt` and its block. Absent when the worker does not report it (a target that is not typeset).

ExportJob.title: ExportJob
ExportJob.description: An export job (05 §6.2; 09 §9.1). It belongs to its requester: only they, and service credentials of the tenant, may read or cancel it (review SR-C4).

seq.description: The content exported: the `seq` asked for, or the head when the request was accepted.

progress.description: Per cent done, from the worker; null while unknown.

error.description: Why the job failed, when `state` is `failed`.

ImportJob.title: ImportJob
ImportJob.description: An import job; it returns warnings on completion (05 §6.2). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

FontManifest.title: FontManifest
FontManifest.description: Font manifest: families, styles, file URLs, hashes, licences, manifest version (05 §6.2). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

WebhookSubscription.title: WebhookSubscription
WebhookSubscription.description: A webhook subscription: event filters, secret rotation, test ping, replay (05 §6.2). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
AuditEntry.description: An audit entry (13 §10). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

SearchResult.title: SearchResult
SearchResult.description: A search result (13 §10). Placeholder: not defined by the prose.

RetentionPolicy.title: RetentionPolicy
RetentionPolicy.description: A retention policy (08 section 11; 13 section 10; UX-080).

mode.description: keep_all keeps every commit payload (the default); thin_payloads keeps only checkpoints after afterDays.

afterDays.description: Days after which commit payloads are thinned. Required with thin_payloads and refused with keep_all.

RetentionView.title: RetentionView
RetentionView.description: A document retention policy with the effective policy (UX-080).

policy.description: The policy the document carries, or null when it carries none.

effective.description: The policy that applies: the document policy, else the tenant policy, else keep_all.

source.description: Where the effective policy comes from.

TenantKeyView.title: TenantKeyView
TenantKeyView.description: A registered public key of a tenant (UX-077; 05 section 3.2).

use.description: user keys verify user tokens; service keys verify service credentials.

thumbprint.description: The RFC 7638 thumbprint of the public key.

issuer.description: The iss the key verifies, or null.

jwk.description: The public key. Private material is never registered.

KeyList.title: KeyList
KeyList.description: The public keys registered for a tenant (UX-077).

keys.description: The keys of the tenant: user keys, then service keys.

OriginList.title: OriginList
OriginList.description: The allowed origins of a tenant (UX-077; 05 section 4).

origins.description: The origins the tenant allows, in order.

KeyRegistration.title: KeyRegistration
KeyRegistration.description: The public key a tenant administrator registers (UX-077; 05 section 3.2).

kid.description: The key identifier, unique within the tenant.

use.description: user keys verify user tokens; service keys verify service credentials.

alg.description: The algorithm the key verifies; symmetric and other algorithms are refused.

jwk.description: The public key as a JWK. A key with private members is refused.

issuer.description: The iss the key verifies, or null for any.

OriginRegistration.title: OriginRegistration
OriginRegistration.description: An origin a tenant administrator allows (UX-077; 05 section 4).

origin.description: An origin: scheme, host and optional port.

QuotaSettings.title: QuotaSettings
QuotaSettings.description: The quota values of a tenant; a dimension is null when no value is set (UX-078; 06 section 12).

connections.description: Connections a tenant may hold at once.

openDocuments.description: Documents a tenant may have open at once.

commitRate.description: Commits a tenant may make in one window.

roomCpuBudget.description: Room CPU milliseconds a tenant may spend in one window.

exportConcurrency.description: Export jobs a tenant may run at once.

exportMinutes.description: Export minutes a tenant may use.

HoldRequest.title: HoldRequest
HoldRequest.description: The body of a legal hold (UX-080; 08 section 11; 13 section 10).

reason.description: Why the document is held. Trimmed; at most 500 characters.

Hold.title: Hold
Hold.description: A legal hold on a document (UX-080; 08 section 11; 13 section 10).

reason.description: The reason the hold was placed with.

placedBy.description: The actor who placed the hold.

placedAt.description: When the hold was placed, ISO 8601 in UTC.

ErasePersonRequest.title: ErasePersonRequest
ErasePersonRequest.description: The body of an erasure of a person (HIS-038; 08 section 13).

sub.description: The host's `sub` of the person to erase. Hosts SHOULD NOT use an e-mail address as `sub` (05 section 3.1).

ErasePersonResult.title: ErasePersonResult
ErasePersonResult.description: What an erasure of a person did (HIS-038; 08 section 13).

outcome.description: `erased`: the mapping, the display name and the read markers are deleted. `deferred`: a document the person wrote in is under legal hold, so the erasure waits for the release (owner decision 38).

TombstoneRequest.title: TombstoneRequest
TombstoneRequest.description: The body of a tombstone of one commit payload (HIS-040; 08 section 13).

reason.description: Why the payload is removed. Trimmed; at most 500 characters. Recorded in the audit trail.

TombstoneResult.title: TombstoneResult
TombstoneResult.description: What a tombstone removed and which copies remain (HIS-040; 08 section 13).

seq.description: The commit whose payload was removed.

removedAt.description: When the payload was removed, ISO 8601 in UTC.

copies.description: The copies that may still hold the removed text; they are not rewritten.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoints at or after the commit, built by replaying it; they may still hold the removed text.

coldSegments.description: Object keys of the cold segments whose range covers the commit.

attributionMap.description: The attribution map may still name runs of the commit.

involves.description: What removing those copies involves, in fixed words.

FieldInfo.title: FieldInfo
FieldInfo.description: A field in the derived list (12 §3.2; FRW-060).

assignee.description: A `role_def` identifier, or null for a field only authors set.

values.description: Values by key, as stored (decimal strings stay strings, 12 §3.3). Placeholder name.

Workflow.title: Workflow
Workflow.description: The workflow resource, from the example of 12 §6.1; which members are required is not stated.

firstViewedAt.description: When the participant first opened the document (12 §6.3; FRW-031).

activatedAt.description: When the participant last became active: the anchor of the reminders (FRW-034).

verifiedAt.description: When a correct access code was submitted for the participant (FRW-039).

BulkSendRow.title: BulkSendRow
BulkSendRow.description: One recipient row of a bulk send: what a document made from the template takes (FRW-063).

participants.description: The recipient's participants, bound to the roles of the template.

values.description: The recipient's values, prefilled by key.

templateSeq.description: The seq of the template document to fork at. Default: the head.

rows.description: One document is made for each row, in order.

BulkSendRowResult.title: BulkSendRowResult
BulkSendRowResult.description: The outcome of one row of a bulk send (FRW-063).

index.description: The position of the row in the request, from 0.

document.description: The document made for the row; null when it failed.

error.description: Why the row failed: the code and the violations the single call would have answered.

BulkSend.title: BulkSend
BulkSend.description: A bulk send: a job that makes one fork of a template for each recipient row (12 §9; FRW-063).

seq.description: The seq of the template the documents are forked at: pinned and recorded.

rows.description: Each row with the new document or the failure; set when `state` is `completed`.

Template.title: Template
Template.description: A template: a document with role placeholders, fields and rules, and no participants (12 §9; FRW-062). The members are the lane's proposal (docs/adr/0406-w4-FRW-062-templates.md).

document.description: The document that is the template.
The document to mark as a template.

reason.description: Why the workflow is stopped: the participant who declines, or the owner who voids, says. A reason that is blank after trimming is refused.

WorkflowAccessCode.title: WorkflowAccessCode
WorkflowAccessCode.description: The body of `verify` and of the registration of an access code (12 §6.1, §7; FRW-039).

code.description: The access code: registered by the host for a participant, and submitted by the participant to verify. It is never stored or returned in the clear.

WorkflowPlaceholder.title: WorkflowPlaceholder
WorkflowPlaceholder.description: A workflow request or response the prose does not define. Placeholder.
